author: Paulioman11
quote:
0/10 An Absolute Disaster!!!!
After more than a decade of waiting, Rockstar Games delivers a broken, frustrating, and narratively disastrous mess with GTA 6 that lets you down on every single front. While the game undeniably looks great on the surface, pretty graphics do nothing to excuse or fix its massive underlying flaws. Technically, it still feels like an early alpha build where textures fail to load, NPCs and vehicles pop in out of nowhere or clip through the ground, mission scripts constantly break and force restarts, and frame rates tank regularly. On top of that, the story is uninspired, packed with plot holes e.g. the child, and drags on endlessly before culminatingin an utterly unsatisfying, anticlimactic ending that leaves you wondering why you wasted dozens of hours getting there. However, the biggest source of frustration in both gameplay and narrative is the dynamic with this girlfriend; she constantly screws things up and makes one terrible decision after another, yet you are forced to do literally everything for her, evenmundane nonsense like painting a room, while cleaning up her messes and taking the fall without ever getting a chance to say no or walk away. Ultimately, nice visuals can’t save a buggy wreck with a miserable story and an insufferable dynamic that drains all the fun out of playing!
SAVE YOUR MONEY!!!
